name: 2017 Laser 1099-MISC Income Federal Copy A(100ct)
description: Popular format for reporting miscellaneous payments and non-employee compensation. Meets all government and IRS filing requirements. Use to Report :Miscellaneous payments, such as rents, royalties, medical and health payments and non-employee compensation. Amounts to Report: Generally $600 or more (All Amounts or $10 or more in some cases). Tax forms per sheet: Two filings per sheet.
